explication: Chromium is a multi-platform browser project. The sampled runtime centers on Ash window management: users drag windows from the shelf or overview, and Ash controllers coordinate overview and split-view behavior. The repository also contains browser, Android WebView, and system UI products; the README identifies Chromium’s broad browser purpose, but the supplied excerpts do not show their end-to-end runtime wiring. The graph therefore emphasizes evidenced Ash interactions and represents other major product areas without guessing connections.
